build_task: build a PHYRE physics task scene with a catapult and dynamic ball using the creator API
make_catapult: create a catapult structure with a base, hinge ball, and top line at given coordinates
add_static_bar: add a static bar object to the PHYRE scene with specified scale, angle, and position
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene with specified scale and position
update_task: update the PHYRE task goal by setting body relationships such as TOUCHING between objects
